# California Chamber of Commerce Advocacy

> The California Chamber of Commerce advocacy hub provides comprehensive policy tracking, legislative positions, and member engagement tools for business advocacy in California.

This site serves as CalChamber's central platform for monitoring and influencing California legislation and elections. It offers members access to bill tracking, policy positions, advocacy action tools, and political engagement resources through platforms like Impact California and Capitol Track.

## Key Topics

- California Chamber of Commerce
- Bill tracking
- Policy positions
- Legislative advocacy
- California legislature
- Political action
- Election engagement
- ChamberPAC
- Business advocacy
- Capitol Track
- Impact California
- Ballot measures
- Federal legislation
- Advocacy priorities

## Policy & Positions

- [Policy](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy): CalChamber's main policy advocacy hub covering legislative positions and business advocacy.
- [Issues](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy/issues): Annual guide to CalChamber's advocacy priorities and policy positions with supporting data.
- [Bill Positions](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/bill-positions): Database of CalChamber's supported and opposed bill positions on California legislation.

## Bill Tracking & Legislative Monitoring

- [Bill Search](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy/bill-tracking/bill-search): Searchable database for California and federal bills with CalChamber policy positions.
- [Federal Bills](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy/bill-tracking/federal-bills): Tracking and positions on federal legislation relevant to CalChamber advocacy interests.
- [Inside the Capitol](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy/inside-the-capitol): Legislative updates and insights on California political developments and bill tracking.

## Advocacy Engagement & Action

- [Impact California](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/impact-california): CalChamber's advocacy platform for policy tracking and political engagement on legislation.
- [Advocacy Action](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/policy/advocacy-action): Action center for CalChamber members to engage in legislative advocacy and political action.

## Elections & Political Engagement

- [Elections](https://advocacy.calchamber.com/elections): CalChamber's election engagement, candidate positions, ballot measures, and PAC information.
